summary.name: Replit Agent
summary.one_liner: Replit Agent is an AI coding agent that builds, tests, and publishes apps and websites from a plain-English description given in chat.
use_cases: Building a production-ready web app from a text description
Prototyping an app idea without coding experience
Automating repetitive workflows with natural-language agents
Connecting an app to Stripe, OpenAI, or a database and auth
summary.what_it_does: Replit Agent takes a description of an app or website and builds it through a chat interface, and users refine it by giving feedback. It can search the web for up-to-date information while working. Optional Extended Thinking and high-power models are available for more complex tasks such as performance optimization or design overhauls. The agent tests its own code, including periodic browser-based testing with generated reports, and fixes issues it finds. It can also build other agents and workflows that integrate with services like Slack or email, and offers built-in Database and User authentication plus third-party connections such as Stripe and OpenAI.
notable: Agent tests and fixes its own code in a browser-based reflection loop
Built-in database and user authentication, with third-party integrations like Stripe
Can build other agents and automations, interacting via Slack or email
Extended Thinking and high-power model options for complex tasks
caveats: Advanced options such as Extended Thinking and High-Power Models are presented as optional for complex tasks; the page does not give their pricing or limits
Page does not state specific pricing tiers; freemium classification comes from the listing
